dedupe_keys.name: kentucky water distribution system models ky1 to ky16 ormsbee university of kentucky

description: KY1 to KY16 are sixteen water distribution networks of Kentucky utilities, contributed by Lindell Ormsbee of the University of Kentucky to the Water Distribution System Research Database. Each entry offers a system description as a PDF plus the network as an EPANET input file and as a KYPIPE file, and DataCite carries DOIs for the KY1 to KY15 deposits. The summary spreadsheet gives, per system, 366 to 2,426 pipes, 1 to 21 pumps, 1 to 4 reservoirs, 2 to 28 tanks and 270 to 2,318 nodes, an average daily demand of about 1.0 to 2.5 million gallons per day, and a grid, loop or branch layout. None is marked as hydraulically or water-quality calibrated, and the spreadsheet marks pipe material and age as available but not pressure class. The entry pages carry no date, but the site and the DOIs date from 2016, and KY16 is listed without an entry page. The files are free to download; the pages state no licence, only a copyright notice of the Kentucky Water Resources Research Institute. Only the index page, the entry pages, the summary spreadsheet and DataCite metadata were read; no network file was downloaded or run. The networks support hydraulic analysis, pump and tank operation studies, and testing of design and resilience algorithms on realistic small systems. Related records: the database record, EPANET, KYPipe and the single KY6 deposit.
